candidates.title: AsymSpec: Efficient Cloud-Edge Speculative Decoding over Asymmetric Networks
candidates.reason: cloud-edge投機的復号でuplink非対称性を考慮したverification protocolとconfirmed-prefix pipelineを設計し、3 network profileで最強baseline比2.82–28.03倍のoutput-token throughput。

candidates.title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
candidates.reason: hybrid-attention LLM向けtree speculative decodingをkernel-runtime共同設計しSGLangへ統合。linear-attention tree verification 3.4–7.7倍、transient state memory 82–99倍削減。

candidates.title: D-cut: Adaptive Verification Depth Pruning for Batched Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: 高concurrency投機的復号でbatch横断のverification budgetをacceptance確率とruntime cost modelに基づき配分。MoEを含む評価で平均speedup 1.26→1.65倍、最大3倍。

candidates.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
candidates.reason: factorized drafterのtop-K marginalからproposal treeを構築するWeaverとGated Delta Net向けrollback-free tree verification CUDA kernelをSGLangへ実装し、自己回帰比4.37倍高速化。

candidates.title: CATS: Cascaded Adaptive Tree Speculation for Memory-Limited LLM Inference Acceleration
candidates.reason: memory-limited edgeでtarget model単体と同じpeak memoryを維持しつつparameter offloading patternに応じてcascaded self-speculationを行う。実機edgeで最大5.08倍高速化。
